as_told.title: Truman-Forrestal memo and first NSC meeting

plain: This story is about the Majestic 12 papers, a set of documents said to describe a secret group set up in 1947 to deal with UFOs. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says one thing that makes the papers convincing is that they give dates when James Forrestal, the US Secretary of Defense, met President Harry Truman in Washington, and those dates line up. He points in particular to a paper known as the Eisenhower briefing document. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells it too, in his own words, and is more specific. He describes a memo from Truman to Forrestal dated 24 September 1947, and brings in the scientist Vannevar Bush, the first meeting of the National Security Council (the president's top security advisers), and the researcher Stanton Friedman. If the dates really match, believers say, it would suggest the papers were written by someone with real inside knowledge of 1947 Washington.
